CAPTURE.description: View Capture (CAPTURE). Captures the current model view to an image; FIGURE_NAME selects a Smart Report figure, otherwise the supplied view-setup options drive the rendering, and URL_NAME/EXPORT_PATH control image export.

Argument.description: Capture request. All fields optional. If FIGURE_NAME is set, the Smart Report figure is used and other view-setup fields are ignored; otherwise ACTIVE/ANGLE/zoom/perspective/background/STAGE_NAME/SET_MODE/DISPLAY/RESULT_GRAPHIC are applied. The image is exported only if URL_NAME or EXPORT_PATH is set.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Output file path for the captured image. If set (and URL_NAME not set), the graphic is exported to this path.

FIGURE_NAME.description: Smart Report figure name. If set, the stored UFIG data for this figure is loaded and rendered, and ACTIVE/ANGLE/STAGE_NAME/SET_MODE/DISPLAY/RESULT_GRAPHIC are ignored.

URL_NAME.description: URL name. If set, the image is exported to a temp .jpg and returned as a base64 string (for M-Connector); takes precedence over EXPORT_PATH.

STAGE_NAME.description: Construction stage name shown in the view (e.g. a stage name, POSTCS, default, or MINMAX). Applied only when FIGURE_NAME is not given.

SET_MODE.description: Set mode option (case-insensitive). PRE switches to pre-processing mode; POST switches to post-processing mode (fails if post is unavailable). Applied only when FIGURE_NAME is not given.

ACTIVE.description: Active option. Applied only when FIGURE_NAME is not given. ACTIVE_MODE drives which other fields are consumed.

ACTIVE_MODE.description: Active operation mode (case-insensitive). 'All' activates everything; 'Active' activates objects in N_LIST/E_LIST; 'Identity' activates objects matched by IDENTITY_TYPE + IDENTITY_LIST.

IDENTITY_LIST.description: [ACTIVE_MODE=Identity] Names of identity targets to activate.

ANGLE.description: View angle option. Applied only when FIGURE_NAME is not given.

DISPLAY.description: Display option. Applied only when FIGURE_NAME is not given; overwrites the pre-processing display data before rendering.

HEAT_OF_HYDRATION_ELEMENT_CONVECTION_BOU.description: Heat of Hydration Element Convection Boundary.

HEAT_OF_HYDRATION_PIPE_COOLING_ELEMENT.description: Heat of Hydration Pipe Cooling Element.

RESULT_GRAPHIC.description: Result graphic (post-processing) option. Applied only when FIGURE_NAME is not given. CURRENT_MODE is required and selects the result type.

CURRENT_MODE.description: Result graphic mode (case-insensitive). Drives which COMPONENTS property is used and which result is drawn.

OPT_CUMULATIVE_DISP_BY_INIT_LOAD.description: Cumulative displacement by initial load option.

COMPONENTS.description: Result components. Set the property whose key matches CURRENT_MODE; other properties are ignored.
